name: Rauthy
description: Rauthy is a single sign-on identity and access management server. It is an OpenID Connect and OAuth 2 provider with an admin UI, passkey (FIDO2/WebAuthn) and OTP multi-factor login, upstream login providers, SCIM, forward auth and PAM/SSH login.

notes.text: Accept the self-signed certificate and sign in as admin@localhost with the password_plain value under [bootstrap] in /opt/rauthy_data/config.toml. Change it right away.

Passkeys need a domain, so admin MFA is off. For production, set pub_url, rp_id and rp_origin to your domain before anyone registers a passkey, then add the admin's passkey and set admin_force_mfa = true.
Back up /opt/rauthy_data/config.toml together with the database in /opt/rauthy_data/hiqlite. Without its encryption keys the database is unusable.
